cells.quote: The relative retardation in speed when the mutilated samples were read indicates again the comparative ease with which B was read and the difficulty involved in interpreting the letter-forms of A and C.
cells.note: The study reports slower reading of mutilated samples descriptively; no significance test or adequate-power/equivalence evidence is reported.
